name: Zacharias
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament

source.name: TIPNR, Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References, by Tyndale House Cambridge, STEPBible.org

cases.name: Zacharias
cases.charge: Not believing the words of the angel Gabriel, and asking for a sign
cases.preview: While Zacharias executed the priest’s office before God in the order of his course, his lot was to burn incense, and the angel Gabriel stood on the right side of the altar and told him his prayer was…

cases.name: Zacharias and Elisabeth
cases.charge: Both righteous before God, walking in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord blameless
cases.preview: Zacharias was a priest of the course of Abia and Elisabeth was of the daughters of Aaron, and they were both righteous before God, walking in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord blameless;
